# oe_romp.1 — Julian's Fragmentary Scroll (human-only whisper opener)
oe_romp.1 = {
    type = country_event
    title = oe_romp.1.title
    desc = oe_romp.1.desc
    outcome = neutral
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_wnd_alexandria.dds"

    trigger = {
        is_ai = no
        NOT = { religion = religion:hellenism_religion }
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp.1.a
        ai_chance = { base = 60 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp.1.a.tt
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_romp_mod_julian_scroll years = 20 mode = replace }
        add_research_progress = research_progress_mild_bonus
        add_estate_satisfaction = {
            type = estate_type:clergy_estate
            value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty
        }
        set_variable = oe_romp_julian_scroll_kept
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp.1.b
        ai_chance = { base = 40 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp.1.b.tt
        add_estate_satisfaction = {
            type = estate_type:clergy_estate
            value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus
        }
        add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
        set_variable = oe_romp_rejected
    }
}

# oe_romp.3 — Wrath of Mount Athos & Patriarchal Rebuke (Option C converts ONLY for human player: is_ai = no!)
oe_romp.3 = {
    type = country_event
    title = oe_romp.3.title
    desc = oe_romp.3.desc
    outcome = neutral
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_ecc_athos.dds"

    trigger = {
        is_ai = no
        NOT = { religion = religion:hellenism_religion }
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp.3.a
        ai_chance = { base = 55 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp.3.a.tt
        add_estate_satisfaction = {
            type = estate_type:clergy_estate
            value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus
        }
        add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
        set_variable = oe_romp_rejected
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp.3.b
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp.3.b.tt
        add_estate_satisfaction = {
            type = estate_type:clergy_estate
            value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty
        }
        culture = { add_cultural_tradition = 4 }
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp.3.c
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
        trigger = {
            is_ai = no
        }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp.3.c.tt
        add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
        add_estate_satisfaction = {
            type = estate_type:clergy_estate
            value = estate_satisfaction_severe_penalty
        }
        religion:hellenism_religion = {
            enable_religion = yes
            set_variable = { name = hellenism_has_omens value = 1 }
        }
        change_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
        hidden_effect = {
            oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
        }
        ruler_or_regent ?= {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { religious_figure ?= religious_figure:cardinal } }
                change_character_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
            }
            every_descendant = {
                limit = {
                    is_alive = yes
                    owner = root
                    NOT = { religious_figure ?= religious_figure:cardinal }
                }
                change_character_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
            }
        }
        heir ?= {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { religious_figure ?= religious_figure:cardinal } }
                change_character_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
            }
        }
        consort ?= {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { religious_figure ?= religious_figure:cardinal } }
                change_character_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
            }
        }
        capital = {
            spawn_movement = {
                movement_definition = movement_definition:hellenism_religion_movement
                supporters = {
                    value = population
                    multiply = 0.15
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_ev4_fired } }
            set_variable = oe_romp_ev4_fired
            trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_romp.4 days = 1 }
        }
    }
}

# oe_romp.4 — Purple-Clad Pontifex Maximus (first conversion coronation, IO creation, Sol Invictus unlocked)
oe_romp.4 = {
    type = country_event
    title = oe_romp.4.title
    desc = oe_romp.4.desc
    outcome = positive
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_mag_carthage_exarch.dds"

    immediate = {
        religion:hellenism_religion = {
            enable_religion = yes
            set_variable = { name = hellenism_has_omens value = 1 }
        }
        oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
        set_variable = oe_romp_unlocked_sol_invictus
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_style_grecoroman }
                NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_style_roman }
            }
            set_variable = oe_romp_style_roman
        }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { unique_international_organization_type_exists = international_organization_type:oe_romp_pontificate } }
            create_international_organization = {
                type = international_organization_type:oe_romp_pontificate
                add_country_to_international_organization = root
                set_leader_country = root
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = oe_romp_pontificate } } }
            international_organization:oe_romp_pontificate ?= {
                add_country_to_international_organization = root
            }
        }
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp.4.a
        ai_chance = { base = 60 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp.4.a.tt
        add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
        add_religious_influence = religious_influence_mild_bonus
        change_societal_value = {
            type = spiritualist_vs_humanist
            value = societal_value_move_to_right
        }
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp.4.b
        ai_chance = { base = 40 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp.4.b.tt
        add_legitimacy = legitimacy_mild_bonus
        add_religious_influence = religious_influence_mild_bonus
        culture = { add_cultural_tradition = 6 }
    }
}

# oe_romp.19 — Sol Invictus and Heliocentrism
oe_romp.19 = {
    type = country_event
    title = oe_romp.19.title
    desc = oe_romp.19.desc
    outcome = positive
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_wnd_alexandria.dds"

    option = {
        name = oe_romp.19.a
        ai_chance = { base = 60 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp.19.a.tt
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_romp_mod_heliocentric_dawn years = 25 mode = replace }
        add_research_progress = research_progress_mild_bonus
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp.19.b
        ai_chance = { base = 40 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp.19.b.tt
        add_religious_influence = religious_influence_mild_bonus
        add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
    }
}

        change_societal_value = {
            type = spiritualist_vs_humanist

}

# oe_romp_ritual.1 — Consultation of the Sibylline Books (triggered by oe_romp_consult_sibylline_books)
oe_romp_ritual.1 = {
    type = country_event
    title = oe_romp_ritual.1.title
    desc = oe_romp_ritual.1.desc
    outcome = positive
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_wnd_alexandria.dds"

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.1.a
        ai_chance = { base = 55 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp_ritual.1.a.tt
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_romp_mod_sibylline_war years = 10 mode = replace }
        if = {
            limit = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:oe_romp_augury_sibylline_aspect }
            add_army_tradition = 8
        }
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.1.b
        ai_chance = { base = 30 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp_ritual.1.b.tt
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_romp_mod_sibylline_plague years = 10 mode = replace }
        if = {
            limit = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:oe_romp_augury_sibylline_aspect }
            add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
        }
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.1.c
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp_ritual.1.c.tt
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_romp_mod_sibylline_peace years = 10 mode = replace }
        if = {
            limit = { has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:oe_romp_augury_sibylline_aspect }
            add_religious_influence = religious_influence_weak_bonus
        }
    }
}

# oe_romp_ritual.2 — Neoplatonic Symposium (triggered by oe_romp_hold_neoplatonic_symposium)
oe_romp_ritual.2 = {
    type = country_event
    title = oe_romp_ritual.2.title
    desc = oe_romp_ritual.2.desc
    outcome = positive
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_wnd_alexandria.dds"

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.2.a
        ai_chance = { base = 60 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp_ritual.2.a.tt
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_romp_mod_symposium_patronage years = 12 mode = replace }
        add_research_progress = research_progress_mild_bonus
        create_character = {
            artist = philosopher
            artist_skill = 0.65
            age = { 28 48 }
            culture = root.culture
            religion = religion:hellenism_religion
            estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:oe_romp_mistra_academy_aspect
                    has_religious_aspect = religious_aspect:monism_aspect
                }
            }
            capital = {
                create_art = {
                    quality = 78
                    type = work_of_art_type:treatise
                    key = oe_romp_art_symposium_dialogues
                }
            }
        }
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.2.b
        ai_chance = { base = 40 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp_ritual.2.b.tt
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_romp_mod_symposium_patronage years = 12 mode = replace }
        culture = { add_cultural_tradition = 8 }
        add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
    }
}

# oe_romp_ritual.10 — Hexapantheon Seat Selector Hub (strictly preserves 2 ADM + 2 DIP + 2 MIL = 6 gods!)
oe_romp_ritual.10 = {
    type = country_event
    title = oe_romp_ritual.10.title
    desc = oe_romp_ritual.10.desc
    outcome = neutral
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_wnd_alexandria.dds"

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.10.a
        ai_chance = { base = 40 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp_ritual.10.a.tt
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp_ritual.12
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.10.b
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp_ritual.10.b.tt
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp_ritual.13
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.10.c
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp_ritual.10.c.tt
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_romp_ritual.14
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.10.d
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
        trigger = {
            OR = {
                has_variable = oe_romp_adm1_custom
                has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_custom
                has_variable = oe_romp_dip1_custom
                has_variable = oe_romp_dip2_custom
                has_variable = oe_romp_mil1_custom
                has_variable = oe_romp_mil2_custom
            }
        }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp_ritual.10.d.tt
        religion:hellenism_religion = { set_variable = { name = hellenism_has_omens value = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm1_custom }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm1_sol_invictus }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus
                remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_sol_invictus
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm1_juno }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_juno_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno
                remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_juno
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm1_vesta }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_vesta_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta
                remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_vesta
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm1_asclepius }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius
                remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_asclepius
            }
            remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_custom
            remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus
            add_god = god:zeus_god
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_custom }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_sol_invictus }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus
                remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_sol_invictus
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_juno }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_juno_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno
                remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_juno
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_vesta }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_vesta_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta
                remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_vesta
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_asclepius }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius
                remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_asclepius
            }
            remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_custom
            remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite
            add_god = god:aphrodite_god
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip1_custom }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip1_janus }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_janus_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus
                remove_variable = oe_romp_dip1_janus
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip1_apollo }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_apollo_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_apollo
                remove_variable = oe_romp_dip1_apollo
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip1_isis_serapis }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_isis_serapis_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_isis_serapis
                remove_variable = oe_romp_dip1_isis_serapis
            }
            remove_variable = oe_romp_dip1_custom
            remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_poseidon
            add_god = god:poseidon_god
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip2_custom }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip2_janus }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_janus_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus
                remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_janus
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip2_apollo }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_apollo_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_apollo
                remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_apollo
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip2_isis_serapis }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_isis_serapis_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_isis_serapis
                remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_isis_serapis
            }
            remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_custom
            remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_hermes
            add_god = god:hermes_god
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_mil1_custom }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_mil1_quirinus_mars }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_quirinus_mars_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_quirinus_mars
                remove_variable = oe_romp_mil1_quirinus_mars
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_mil1_mithras }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_mithras_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_mithras
                remove_variable = oe_romp_mil1_mithras
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_mil1_cybele }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_cybele_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_cybele
                remove_variable = oe_romp_mil1_cybele
            }
            remove_variable = oe_romp_mil1_custom
            remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_ares
            add_god = god:ares_god
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_mil2_custom }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_mil2_quirinus_mars }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_quirinus_mars_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_quirinus_mars
                remove_variable = oe_romp_mil2_quirinus_mars
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_mil2_mithras }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_mithras_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_mithras
                remove_variable = oe_romp_mil2_mithras
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_mil2_cybele }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_cybele_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_cybele
                remove_variable = oe_romp_mil2_cybele
            }
            remove_variable = oe_romp_mil2_custom
            remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_athena
            add_god = god:athena_god
        }
        oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
    }

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.10.e
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp_ritual.10.e.tt
    }
}

# oe_romp_ritual.12 — ADM Pillar Hexapantheon Swapper (Seat 1: Jupiter / Seat 2: Venus)
oe_romp_ritual.12 = {
    type = country_event
    title = oe_romp_ritual.12.title
    desc = oe_romp_ritual.12.desc
    outcome = neutral
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_wnd_alexandria.dds"

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.12.a
        ai_chance = { base = 40 }
        trigger = {
            has_variable = oe_romp_unlocked_sol_invictus
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus }
        }
        custom_tooltip = oe_romp_ritual.12.a.tt
        hidden_effect = {
            religion:hellenism_religion = { set_variable = { name = hellenism_has_omens value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_sol_invictus }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus
                remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_sol_invictus
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_juno }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_juno_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno
                remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_juno
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_vesta }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_vesta_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta
                remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_vesta
            }

# oe_romp_ritual.13 — DIP Pillar Hexapantheon Swapper (Seat 1: Neptune / Seat 2: Mercury)
oe_romp_ritual.13 = {
    type = country_event
    title = oe_romp_ritual.13.title
    desc = oe_romp_ritual.13.desc
    outcome = neutral
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_maritime_silk_road.dds"

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.13.a
        ai_chance = { base = 40 }
        trigger = {
            has_variable = oe_romp_unlocked_janus

        }

        hidden_effect = {
            religion:hellenism_religion = { set_variable = { name = hellenism_has_omens value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip2_janus }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_janus_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus
                remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_janus
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip2_apollo }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_apollo_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_apollo
                remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_apollo
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip2_isis_serapis }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_isis_serapis_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_isis_serapis
                remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_isis_serapis
            }
            else = {
                remove_god = god:hermes_god
                set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_hermes
            }
            set_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus

    type = country_event
    title = oe_romp_ritual.14.title

    outcome = neutral

    option = {
        name = oe_romp_ritual.14.a

        hidden_effect = {
            religion:hellenism_religion = { set_variable = { name = hellenism_has_omens value = 1 } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_mil1_quirinus_mars }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_quirinus_mars_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_quirinus_mars
                remove_variable = oe_romp_mil1_quirinus_mars
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_mil1_mithras }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_mithras_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_mithras
                remove_variable = oe_romp_mil1_mithras
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_mil1_cybele }
                remove_god = god:oe_romp_cybele_god
                remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_cybele
